violations.why: req4_isr can preempt JudgeCondi between its two reads of test_global_var1. The two reads can then see different values.
req2_isr, at equal priority, can preempt req1_isr between its two writes. It then reads the intermediate value 0x33.
req2_isr can overwrite irq after req1_isr stores it and before pca_isa_probe reads it. The probe then sees a different value.
req4_isr can overwrite irq with -1 between req3_isr's write and its check. The irq==3 test then fails.
req3_isr can overwrite irq between req4_isr's write and its check. The irq==-1 test then fails.
Another ISR's pca_isa_exit or pca_isa_init can change global_id between this ISR's init write and its probe read. The probe then compares against a clobbered value.
Another ISR's pca_isa_exit can overwrite global_dev between this ISR's init write and its probe read.
